geography: Worldwide (Shire FOSRENOL product sales row; royalties on FOSRENOL sold by licensees are a separate row and are excluded)

approval_evidence.quote: 10/26/2004 ORIG-1 Approval Type 1 - New Molecular Entity STANDARD (NDA 021468, FOSRENOL)

launch_evidence.quote: FOSRENOL: FDA approval received in October 2004 and shipments commenced in the US in December 2004. First sales in January 2005 captured 3.3% of total new prescriptions in the US phosphate binder market

series_start_reason: Series starts at the launch quarter: shipments began in December 2004 and first sales were in January 2005; the Q1 2005 release prints FOSRENOL 4,897 (USD thousands) with a dash for the prior year, and the 2005 quarters sum to the full year 53,516 printed in the Q4 2005 release, so no 2004 sales were recorded.
series_end_reason: The Q1 2016 release (filed 2016-04-29, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/936402/000095010316012957/dp65192_ex9901.htm, row 'FOSRENOL | 37.7 | 44.1') is the last with a FOSRENOL product sales row. From the Q2 2016 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/936402/000095010316015247/dp67599_ex9901.htm) every FOSRENOL row is labelled 'FOSRENOL royalties' (e.g. 'FOSRENOL royalties | 11.4 | 10.8 | 20.6 | 19.2'), a different measure, and no product sales row appears in any later Shire release.
search_log: Listed every Shire plc (CIK 936402) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. older pages (all forms); fetched every 8-K/8-K/A filed 2004-07 to 2019-02 whose items include 2.02, 12, 9 or 7.01 (or carry none), with every exhibit from each filing's index.json, plus every 10-Q/10-K primary document; table rows naming the brand were extracted from every exhibit (rows.py).

Shire releases print FOSRENOL in the product sales table and, from 2011, also in the royalties table; each quarter is the product-sales three-month row (first figure the quarter, next figure the prior-year quarter where one exists), and values were chosen so the four quarters reproduce the full-year product-sales row of the Q4 release. 2005 rows are the release tables stated in USD thousands.
